snippet.title: Speed Racing (Italic Games) - Review of a classic Android game - Part I
snippet.description: Speed Racing is a racing game released by Italic Games on December 2nd, 2012. It was last updated on May 20th, 2019 and is missing from Google Play Store as of December 2024.
